channel.title: Holistic Life: High Protein Dinner Ideas
channel.description: High Protein Dinner Ideas guides from Holistic Life.

item.title: Easy High Protein Dinner: Egg Fried Rice With Shrimp or Tofu
item.description: An easy high protein dinner for a busy weeknight: egg fried rice with shrimp or tofu, made in one skillet. The guide has the ingredient list, a simple swap and four more high protein dinners ready in about 30 minutes. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: High Protein Meals in One Pan: Quick Chicken and Skillet Dinners
item.description: High protein meals for tired evenings, made in one pan. Chicken thighs with vegetables, a turkey bean skillet and more, ready in about 30 minutes. Simple steps and a swap for each. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Easy High Protein Meals for Busy Weeknights: A 5-Night Dinner Plan
item.description: Easy high protein meals for busy weeknights, planned as five dinners. Chicken, turkey, salmon, eggs and beans are the stars, with swaps for what is in your kitchen. Short ingredient lists and quick steps. Guide contains affiliate links.
